Ace Bailey scored the Jazz's first basket more than anyone in 2025-26: 13 times in 61 starts, or 21% of the games they started. Lauri Markkanen was next with 13. The Jazz made the game's first field goal in 55% of their 82 games and won 57% of their opening tipoffs. Everything below is counted from the play-by-play of every 2025-26 game (1,225 regular season, 85 playoffs, 6 play-in).
